scenario.opening_question: What matters most for our vacation rental: location, amenities, or cost?

options.name: Lakefront Cabin in Adirondack Mountains
options.upside: Scenic lake views with private beach access
options.tradeoff: Longer drive from airport and fewer nearby restaurants
options.concern: Limited cell service and spotty internet connectivity

options.name: Modern Condo Downtown Asheville
options.upside: Close to restaurants, shops, and cultural events
options.tradeoff: Smaller living space and no outdoor private area
options.concern: Potential noise from nightlife and street traffic
options.best_for: Urban experience with easy access to amenities

options.name: Spacious Beach House in Outer Banks

options.tradeoff: Highest cost and peak season availability challenges
options.concern: Potential for crowded beaches and tourist traffic
options.best_for: Family-friendly beach vacation with ample room

options.name: Mountain Chalet near Gatlinburg

options.concern: Possible wildlife encounters and steep access roads
options.best_for: Outdoor adventure with comfort and privacy

shared_context: We are three adults deciding for four families total
